privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy describes how Propely ("we", "us", or "our") collects, uses, and protects your personal information when you use our platform. We are committed to protecting your privacy and handling your data transparently.
privacy.accountInfo: When you register, we collect your name, email address, and password (stored as a salted hash). If you sign in via Google or GitHub OAuth, we receive your public profile information from those providers.
privacy.usageData: We automatically collect information about how you interact with our platform, including pages visited, features used, browser type, IP address, and timestamps. This data helps us improve the service.
privacy.paymentData: Payment processing is handled entirely by Stripe. We do not store your credit card number or full payment details on our servers. We retain only your Stripe customer ID, subscription status, and billing history references.
privacy.aiServiceData: When you use AI-powered features, your input text is sent to OpenAI for processing. We do not use your data to train AI models. OpenAI processes the data according to their API data usage policy and does not retain it beyond processing.
privacy.howWeUseItems: To provide and maintain the platform and your account;To process subscriptions and payments through Stripe;To send transactional emails (account verification, password resets, invitations) via SendGrid;To provide AI-powered features through OpenAI;To improve our platform based on usage analytics;To respond to your support requests;To comply with legal obligations
privacy.thirdPartyIntro: We share your data with the following third-party services, each with their own privacy policies:
privacy.stripe: Processes payments and manages subscriptions. Stripe receives your payment details, billing address, and email. See Stripe's Privacy Policy.
privacy.sendgrid: Sends transactional emails on our behalf. SendGrid receives recipient email addresses and email content. See SendGrid's Privacy Policy.
privacy.googleOAuth: Provides social sign-in. When you authenticate with Google, we receive your name, email, and profile picture. See Google's Privacy Policy.
privacy.githubOAuth: Provides social sign-in. When you authenticate with GitHub, we receive your username, email, and avatar. See GitHub's Privacy Statement.
privacy.openai: Powers AI features. Input text is sent to OpenAI's API for processing and is not used for model training. See OpenAI's Privacy Policy.
privacy.storage: Your data is stored in PostgreSQL databases and cached in Redis, hosted on secure cloud infrastructure. We use TLS encryption for all data in transit, salted hashing for passwords, and role-based access controls. RabbitMQ handles internal message processing with no external exposure.
privacy.gdprIntro: If you are in the European Economic Area (EEA), you have the following rights under the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR):
privacy.gdprAccessDesc: Request a copy of the personal data we hold about you.
privacy.gdprRectificationDesc: Request correction of inaccurate personal data.
privacy.gdprErasureDesc: Request deletion of your personal data ("right to be forgotten").
privacy.gdprPortabilityDesc: Request your data in a structured, machine-readable format.
privacy.gdprRestrictionDesc: Request that we limit the processing of your data.
privacy.gdprObjectionDesc: Object to the processing of your personal data for certain purposes.
privacy.gdprExercise: To exercise any of these rights, contact us at the email address below. We will respond within 30 days.
privacy.cookies: We use essential cookies for authentication and session management. These are strictly necessary for the platform to function and cannot be disabled. We do not use advertising or tracking cookies.
privacy.retention: We retain your account data for as long as your account is active. If you delete your account, we will remove your personal data within 30 days, except where retention is required by law (e.g., billing records). Usage analytics are anonymized after 90 days.
privacy.children: Our platform is not intended for users under 16 years of age. We do not knowingly collect personal data from children. If you believe a child has provided us with personal data, please contact us and we will delete it.
privacy.changes: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of significant changes by email or through a notice on the platform. Your continued use after changes constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.
privacy.contact: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy or wish to exercise your data rights, contact us at:
